benchmark.scope: Synchronous plugin ensure-layer/ink-redraw processing; excludes native PDF.js rendering, GPU completion and physical tablet latency
benchmark.tradeoff: First display constructs cached paths; subsequent zoom reuses them. Caches are runtime-only.

regressions: cached and live path pixels agree at 60%, 100%, 110% and 150%
new natural-pressure strokes reuse one path across zoom
color changes reuse geometry; width and geometry edits invalidate it
in-place committed edits cannot reuse stale paths
earlier renderers retain exact size-specific outlines and bounded cache sizes
a real aspect change rebuilds geometry
rendering cannot mutate stored stroke data
hidden zero-size canvases cannot poison cache paths
sidebar refresh produces one placement icon and no left/right text
tooltip and accessible description remain; mobile/desktop headers align without horizontal overflow
existing Markdown autosave, pressure tips, eraser, undo/redo, association and zoom-recovery workflows pass
visual: Inspected generated sidebar screenshot; placement and collapse controls are square icon-only buttons
limitations: No physical iPad timing measurement or new native Obsidian performance capture in this version.
